source: the hub's one recorded ask in Cawco-Dev: Caw's question in his thread, thread_messages.question (hub DB copy 2026-10-25 11:13)
question: Six wire breaks from the preview-ports change are already on main and break 0.1.11 builds (CanvasExport.port, Rule.interrupt ×3, and the /shown body no longer accepting error "hub"). How should they be handled?

options.label: Raise WIRE_PROTOCOL (Recommended)
options.description: Bump WIRE_PROTOCOL 6→7 on main so old builds see 'hub is newer, update' instead of failing reads silently. No compatibility shims; matches the cutover rule.

options.label: Restore the old shapes
options.description: Put back what 0.1.11 reads and sends (port, interrupt, accept error "hub") so the shipped app keeps working until the next TestFlight.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: Ship the next build and accept that 0.1.11 misbehaves until people update.
